Read to verify that the experiments use BERT, RoBERTa and DeBERTa-based systems rather than the leading generative models named in the post.

evidence_items.publisher: Shane Storks, Qiaozi Gao, Yichi Zhang and Joyce Chai / arXiv
evidence_items.locator: Abstract; experimental population checked in full-paper Section 4
evidence_items.explanation: TRIP documents difficulties connecting physical story judgments to supporting states and conflicts. Its BERT-family systems and physical-only coverage do not establish the complete claim about contemporary leading LLMs and both domains.

PaLM's commonsense results show meaningful competence using natural-language prompting, limiting a blanket reading of weakness. The combined statement also covers calculator-assisted arithmetic, and does not establish robust competence across both physical and psychological reasoning.

unresolved_gaps: The collected contemporaneous evaluations do not jointly cover the leading models and varied tasks in both stated domains.
Neither failures nor benchmark successes establish the stronger inherent-weakness component.
No supplied threshold distinguishes systematic weakness from substantial but imperfect competence.
